title: From chosen algebraic-closure nodal fibres to all geometric points
statement: Let $f:Y\to S$ be a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] locally finitely presented morphism [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] of schemes whose nonempty scheme-theoretic fibres are pure of dimension $1$ [def-weil-pure-dimension]. For each $s\in S$, choose an algebraic closure $k_s$ of $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure, def-weil-residue-field]. Assume every nonsmooth point of $Y_{\bar s}=Y\times_S\operatorname{Spec}k_s$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre] has maximal-ideal-adic completed local ring [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] isomorphic to $k_s[[u,v]]/(uv)$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Then for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ and morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$, lying over $s$, one can choose an embedding $k_s\hookrightarrow\Omega$ extending $\kappa(s)\to\Omega$, and associating fibre products identifies $Y_\Omega$ with $Y_{\bar s}\times_{k_s}\Omega$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Every such $Y_\Omega$ is empty or pure of dimension $1$ and every nonsmooth point has completed local ring $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$. Moreover the relative smooth locus $U\subseteq Y$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] is open. For every $S'\to S$ the smooth locus of $Y\times_SS'\to S'$ is exactly $U\times_SS'$. Thus a point nonsmooth after this base change maps to a nonsmooth point of $f$. No quasi-compactness or Noetherian hypothesis on $S$ is imposed.

proof.text: Fix a geometric point $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ over $s$; by [def-weil-geometric-point] it is the composite of $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$, induced by a field homomorphism $\kappa(s)\to\Omega$, with the canonical morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-algebraic-extension-embeds-algebraically-closed] to $\kappa(s)\to k_s$ and $\kappa(s)\to\Omega$: the former is algebraic and the latter has algebraically closed target. The resulting field homomorphism $k_s\to\Omega$ is injective. By the universal property [def-pc-fibre-product], $Y_\Omega\cong(Y\times_S\operatorname{Spec}k_s)\times_{k_s}\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$: maps into either side are precisely compatible maps into $Y$ and $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, since the map into $\operatorname{Spec}k_s$ is forced by the latter.

source.place: Tag 0C56, lemma-node-field-extension, choosing compatible algebraic closures; Fields Tag 09GU, lemma-map-into-algebraic-closure.

proof.text: A finitely presented algebra is finitely generated (retain its finitely many polynomial generators), so the affine presentations in [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] make $f$ locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. By [lem-weil-pbc-lft-base-change], $C=Y_{\bar s}$ is locally of finite type over $k_s$. Apply [lem-trf-relative-dimension-base-change] with $d=1$ to $f$, first along $\operatorname{Spec}k_s\to S$ and then along $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$: both resulting schemes are empty or pure of dimension $1$.

The hypothesis gives exactly the completed-local-ring condition at every nonsmooth point of $C$. Thus [lem-trf-node-algebraically-closed-extension], applied to the algebraically closed fields $k_s\subseteq\Omega$ and the locally finite type $C$ of Step 2, gives $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{C_\Omega,y}\cong\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$ for every nonsmooth $y$. The isomorphism of Step 1 identifies $C_\Omega$ with $Y_\Omega$ over $\Omega$, so this proves the asserted nodality. The cited statement allows empty $C$ and needs no quasi-compactness.

Let $U$ be the union of the open subschemes of $Y$ on which $f$ is smooth. It is open, and [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-local-on-source] makes $f|_U$ smooth, so this is precisely the relative smooth locus. For any $S\prime\to S$, apply [lem-sfb-scheme-flat-smooth-point-base-change] to the given flat locally finitely presented $f$. It says pointwise that $f\prime$ is smooth at $y\prime$ if and only if $f$ is smooth at its image. Hence its smooth open subscheme has underlying open $p^{-1}(U)$, and by the universal property [def-pc-fibre-product] (a morphism into $Y\times_SS\prime$ factors through $p^{-1}(U)$ exactly when its component to $Y$ factors through $U$) this open subscheme is $U\times_SS\prime$. Taking complements proves the final nonsmooth-image assertion. These statements require neither quasi-compactness nor a Noetherian base.

Step 1: 09GU with K=kappa(s), L=k_s gives psi:k_s->Omega, and fibre-product associativity follows from the universal property. Step 2: lfp implies lft (Stacks 01TW, proof omitted there), so 01T4 and 02NK (d=1) apply along Spec k_s and Spec Omega, where the only fibre is the whole scheme. The tool_use lem-sfb-scheme-flat-smooth-point-base-change is a generic 02V4 lemma; accepted. Edge cases checked: empty Y, k[u,v]/(uv) with transcendental Omega, nonclosed s, non-Noetherian base.
